data.title: Offer to extend fixed-term employment permanently
data.summary: Beispiel Pflegeheim am Park gGmbH offers to continue your fixed-term contract, which ends on 30 June 2027, as a permanent full-time contract from 1 July 2027. They ask for your decision within 6 working days of the letter date (16 April 2027).
data.explanation: Your employer offers to turn your fixed-term job as a nursing professional (Pflegefachkraft) into a permanent one from 1 July 2027, on unchanged full-time terms. They ask for your answer within 6 working days of the letter date, counting Monday to Saturday but not public holidays. The app shows the date. If you don't reply in time, they plan to fill the position otherwise. Consider checking the new contract before signing; a counselling service or employment lawyer can help if unsure.

items.title: Reply to permanent contract offer
items.action: Decide whether to accept the offer of a permanent contract and tell the employer.
items.consequence: The employer plans to fill the position otherwise.
items.quote: Ihre Entscheidung erbitten wir binnen 6 Werktagen ab Datum dieses Schreibens; als Werktage zählen dabei Montag bis Samstag, gesetzliche Feiertage nicht.
